questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A train travelling at 30 m/s applies its brakes and decelerates uniformly at 5 m/s². How far does it travel before coming to a complete stop?
questions.explanation: Using v² = u² + 2as with v = 0, u = 30 m/s, a = -5 m/s²: 0 = 30² - 2(5)s => 10s = 900 => s = 90 m.
